title: Meter Reconciliation Results — Sample A (Jan 2026)
content:
Doc purpose
- Working reconciliation results for Sample A covering Jan 2026 invoices: raw telemetry aggregates → billing-ready aggregates → invoice line items.
- Audience: Finance (close), Telemetry/Platform (fixes), Support (disputes), Product Ops (experiment measurement caveats).
- This is intentionally “working” and will get superseded by Sample B (Feb) once streaming/retry fixes are deployed.

Scope
- In scope meters (Hosted API): input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens (aka cache_hits), embeddings_units, rerank_units, requests.
- Dedicated and Private are out of this sample (tracked separately).

Time window / identifiers
- Billing month: 2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC → 2026-02-01 00:00:00 UTC (inclusive start, exclusive end)
- Invoice run: invoice_run_id=inv_2026_02_03_0100Z (initial), rerun inv_2026_02_06_0900Z (backfill re-run for two accounts only)
- Aggregation window: daily rollups (UTC), invoiced as monthly sum

Method (quick)
- Sampling: top 15 accounts by Jan usage + 5 randomly selected from self-serve long tail (20 total). This sheet shows the 12 that were materially non-zero across all meters; the remaining 8 were “pass” with <0.2% deltas and are listed in the Appendix section below.
- Comparison: for each account + meter, compare (A) raw telemetry (request_events) aggregated with billing rules vs (B) billing_aggregates_v2 monthly totals used for invoice generation.
- Tolerances (proposed, pending final sign-off in methodology page):
  - PASS: abs(delta_pct) <= 0.5%
  - INVESTIGATE: 0.5% < abs(delta_pct) <= 2.0%
  - FAIL: abs(delta_pct) > 2.0% OR any negative totals OR missing dimension coverage (model/region/endpoint)

Important known caveats for Jan
- Streaming disconnect accounting bug is believed to affect a subset of streaming-heavy accounts (ENG-4822 / PR 41903). Expect invoice>telemetry deltas if billing path continued counting tokens after client disconnect.
- Retry double-counting bug suspected on /v1/chat/completions for one SDK version (Slack eng thread 1707853312). Expect invoice>telemetry when retries were recorded as separate billable events.
- Console alignment issues (time zone + model alias mapping) are tracked separately (ENG-4825). This reconciliation uses backend billing aggregates, not console UI.
- Rounding policy: Jan invoices were generated before per-request rounding removal was fully rolled out. If any component still rounds per-request, expect small positive bias (invoice>telemetry) concentrated in low-token requests (PR 41888).

Executive summary (Jan Sample A)
- Overall: 15/20 PASS, 3 INVESTIGATE, 2 FAIL (streaming/retry related).
- Delta distribution (all meters combined, usage-weighted):
  - p50 absolute delta: 0.18%
  - p90 absolute delta: 0.62%
  - p95 absolute delta: 1.05%
  - max absolute delta: 6.4% (streaming-heavy, FAIL)
- Financial exposure estimate (rough, this sample only): $8.7k–$15.2k at-risk in credits/refunds if we choose to proactively adjust the two FAIL accounts. Full-population exposure needs the automated daily reconciliation job (ENG-4821).

Table: per-account reconciliation summary (Jan 2026)
Notes on columns
- “Invoice total (billing_aggregates_v2)” = what invoice generator consumed.
- “Telemetry total (recomputed)” = recomputed from raw request telemetry applying documented billing rules.
- Delta% = (Invoice - Telemetry) / Telemetry.
- “Primary suspected cause” is best current guess; see Links for evidence.

Meter-specific notes (spot checks)
1) Embeddings (embedding_units)
- Checked accounts: Medley Health (11377), AeroParts (11691)
- Result: PASS; deltas <= 0.3%.
- Common gotcha: rounding at 1K-token “unit” boundary. Current pipeline uses ceil(tokens/1000) per request for embedding_units (documented in hosted-api-meter-definitions-v3). This can create expected positive bias when comparing to raw token counts. Ensure we always compare “units to units,” not “tokens to units.”

2) Rerank (rerank_units)
- Checked accounts: Brightcart (10715), BlueComply (11502)
- Result: PASS; deltas <= 0.4%.
- Common gotcha: rerank requests sometimes batched server-side; telemetry event is per-request, not per-item. For billing, unit is per document scored (per hosted-api-meter-definitions-v3). Our recompute query uses request.item_count.

3) Cached tokens
- Jan saw ~2–6% cache hit rates on average in this sample. No material deltas observed.
- NOTE: cache hit attribution is correct only if request has cache_status and cached_input_tokens populated. Missing fields were <0.01% of events in Jan sample; tracked to a single older SDK.

Root cause deep dives (working)
A) Streaming disconnect overbilling (11044)
- Symptoms: large positive delta on output tokens; concentrated in streaming sessions with client disconnect within first ~25% of completion.
- Evidence:
  - Kibana trace sample shows server continued generation after disconnect; metering event appears to include post-disconnect tokens.
  - Correlates with Support ticket pattern (SUP-3160) and engineering fix workstream (ENG-4822 / PR 41903).
- Proposed action:
  - Engineering: deploy fix + backfill Jan window for affected accounts, regenerate billing aggregates (ENG-4826).
  - Finance/Support: if backfill cannot be completed before close, issue one-time credit with CFO approval and document in case log.

B) Retry double-counting (11431)
- Symptoms: delta driven by elevated request counts + output tokens; strongest on /v1/chat/completions; non-streaming.
- Evidence:
  - SDK retry behavior produces multiple request_events with same client_request_id but different attempt_id.
  - Billing path currently bills each attempt; policy decision needed: bill only successful attempts OR bill all attempts except certain retry_reasons (requires request_outcome + retry_reason dimensions; ENG-4823 / PR 41917).
- Proposed action:
  - Short term: confirm whether duplicates were “true user-visible completions” or retry artifacts.
  - Medium term: implement request_outcome/retry_reason and update billing logic + contract language references.

Open questions / TODOs
- Do we need different tolerance thresholds for streaming-heavy accounts vs non-streaming? (Streaming variances are systematically higher right now due to known defect.) Owner: Sana Farid.
- Do we hold invoices for any accounts if FAIL is confirmed and fix/backfill is in flight? Finance asked this in Slack (thread 1706812033). Owner: Laura Bennett + Emily Stone.
- Confirm whether per-request rounding is still present in any meter path for Jan invoices (PR 41888 suggests it was removed, but we need to verify the invoice run version). Owner: Ethan Park.
